Priya (Acct Exec): Quick update — Gondola wants a 1:1 replacement POC for their current vendor. Main asks: identical request/response shape, minimal prompt changes, SOC2 + KMS, and a 3-week test with ~1M tokens. Can SEs scope technical POC and security ask?

Marta (Sales Eng): Happy to. First pass checklist: API surface mapping, header/auth parity, prompt/response normalization, token accounting, and privacy/KMS. Also need to flag any enterprise blockers (eg. static IP allowlist, private deployment).

Evan (Customer Success): They're insisting on customer-managed KMS and a VPC peering option. Also want SLAs for latency during the POC window. Likely needs Private (VPC) or Dedicated.

Kai (Platform Eng): For the compat shim we can do header and body mapping at the ingress proxy. Example mapping prototype: ```# proxy mapping example
# copy incoming Authorization -> X-Client-Auth for our runtime
proxy_set_header X-Client-Auth $http_authorization;
proxy_set_header X-Request-Id $http_x_request_id;```This preserves client auth semantics.

Kai (Platform Eng): Note on model output parity — we will not guarantee bit-for-bit outputs vs their vendor. We can run prompt parity evals and produce a drift matrix. Tokenization differences can change token counts by ~1-3% depending on edge punctuation. Recommend canonicalizing prompts (strip trailing whitespace, normalize quotes) before claim of "parity".

Priya (Acct Exec): Pricing question from procurement: can we do a fixed POC rate for 3 weeks (they propose $X flat to cover the 1M tokens) vs pay-as-you-go?

Marta (Sales Eng): We can offer a timeboxed POC credit model: e.g., 500k free + discounted overage for the remainder. Need finance approval. Also call out that Dedicated capacity or Private incurs base platform fees. I'll draft a pricing note.

Evan (Customer Success): Security questionnaire — they sent a 40-page vendor security PDF. sec-bot, can you confirm we've got the latest SOC2 + encryption at rest docs attached?

sec-bot: Questionnaire received (gondola-security-2026.pdf). SOC2 report v2025-11 and KMS integration guide attached to ticket #4521.

Marta (Sales Eng): Enterprise blocker to highlight: Gondola requires inbound IP allowlist for webhook callbacks and wants guaranteed egress IPs for Dedicated. Kai — can you supply the CIDR ranges and confirm static NAT options for Private?

Kai (Platform Eng): Yes — for Dedicated we can reserve static egress IPs; for Private deployment they can bring their own NAT. Example CRD for canary rollout to limit exposure: ```rollout:
  strategy: canary
  steps:
    - percent: 10
    - wait: 10m
    - percent: 50
    - wait: 30m
    - percent: 100
  fallback: hosted-backup
```This config will let us pin 10% traffic to the compat adapter, watch logs, and fallback automatically.

Priya (Acct Exec): Great — next actions: Marta to send initial SOW and pricing draft by EOD tomorrow. Kai to post the static IP list + short runbook for ingress mapping. Evan to confirm whether Gondola will accept SOC2 + our signed DPA or insists on a Private deployment. I'll loop in legal if DPA changes.

Marta (Sales Eng): I'll also propose an eval rubric: 1) API contract parity (200 sample requests) 2) latency P95 < 300ms for their median payload 3) token accounting delta < 5% 4) sample prompts regression tests. I'll attach the eval harness and a sample script: ```python
# sample eval harness snippet
import requests
for p in prompts:
    r = requests.post(url, json={"input": p})
    compare(r.json(), golden[p])
```

Evan (Customer Success): I'll pre-fill the security questionnaire with our standard answers and mark any items that need engineering input (KMS key rotation policy, network diagrams).

Kai (Platform Eng): One more engineering note — there is a subtle difference in how the competitor pads system messages which can change completions. We'll add a QA step to strip or normalize system message padding in the compatibility layer.

Priya (Acct Exec): Thanks all. If we can get the static IPs + SOW + pricing by EOD tomorrow I'll kick off legal and procurement on Gondola's side. @Marta please cc @Evan on the SOW. :thumbsup:

Marta (Sales Eng): Will do. cc @Evan. :rocket:
